states.name: Tennessee

attribution.text: Data: Tennessee Wildlife Resources Agency (TWRA), trout stocking schedule (https://www.tn.gov/twra/fishing/trout-information-stockings.html).

states.disclaimer: Trout Truck is independent and is not endorsed by TWRA or the State of Tennessee. These are TWRA's scheduled dates, not confirmed stockings. TWRA: "Any stocking event could be postponed or cancelled due to unforeseen problems such as adverse weather or warm water temperatures." A week-of date is a Sunday, and TWRA says the stocking falls within five days after it.

license.summary: TWRA's schedule is information posted on TN.gov. The TN.gov Linking Policy lets it be copied when it is presented in a non-misleading way, implies no endorsement by the State, and identifies the agency and its web address, which every page and screen that shows it does.

sources.name: TN.gov Linking Policy (covers information posted on TN.gov)
sources.terms_quote: The information posted on a TN.gov Web site may be copied so long as it is presented in a non-misleading way and does not imply that either the site owner or the information, as it is presented on the site owner's Web site, is endorsed by the State.
